diagnostic_evidence.quote: $\rhof{\cdot}$ is a seminorm on the vector space $\R^{p} \times \R^{p\times q}$

issues.failure_explanation: The step from (eq_estEtniDelFtnij) to (eq_estDelFtnij) bounds E[ρ²(E_{t_{n,j}}ΔΘ - E_{t_{n,i}}ΔΘ)] by E[ρ²(ΔΘ) - ρ²(E_{t_n}ΔΘ)]. This is a Pythagorean identity for martingale increments. It holds only when ρ² comes from a (semi-)inner product. For a general seminorm (e.g. ℓ¹ or sup type), the identity and the resulting bound can fail. The hypothesis is not stated or proved.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add to Assumption assu_FLipVar that ρ² is induced by a positive semi-definite quadratic form. Both lemmas that verify the assumption satisfy this.
issues.overall_effect: For non-Hilbertian seminorms the stability lemma is unsupported. Both concrete uses (the seminorm |y| and the Euclidean norm) are Hilbertian, so the applications survive.
